content: The session is a FreetoShop engineering task to implement a Clone Stamp tool and broader retouch/paint workflows in a local-first browser image editor. The assistant began by inspecting the repository structure and reading ARCHITECTURE.md and DOCUMENT_MODEL.md to understand existing systems. The codebase is a monorepo with apps/web and packages including core-document, command-history, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, pixel-storage, and others. Key architectural boundaries: apps/web owns interaction/UI, core-document owns serializable editor state with tiled pixel stores and copy-on-write, command-history handles undo/redo, compositor handles blend modes, renderer produces Canvas 2D output without mutating documents. The assistant has not yet started implementing Clone Stamp.

The assistant began by inspecting the repository structure and reading ARCHITECTURE.md and DOCUMENT_MODEL.md to understand existing systems. The codebase is a monorepo with apps/web and packages including core-document, command-history, compositor, renderer, raster-engine, selection-engine, filter-engine, transform-engine, text-engine, file-codecs, persistence, pixel-storage, and others. Key architectural boundaries: apps/web owns interaction/UI, core-document owns serializable editor state with tiled pixel stores and copy-on-write, command-history handles undo/redo, compositor handles blend modes, renderer produces Canvas 2D output without mutating documents. The assistant has not yet started implementing Clone Stamp. During the observed segment, the assistant extended the editor type system: added 'cloneStamp' to the Tool union, defined CloneSourceAlignMode ('aligned'|'unaligned'), a CloneSource interface (document-space x/y plus aligned mode), and a CloneStampGesture interface (kind, points, layerId, target, source, sourceLayerId, destination/source widths and heights), and added a corresponding 'cloneStamp' gesture variant to the Gesture union. The tool family registry type ToolFamilyId was also extended with 'cloneStamp'. An initial edit attempt failed due to a malformed edit-argument encoding, then a corrected edit succeeded. The base capsule's covered_end_event_id remains replay_evt_000017, while the snapshot now runs through replay_evt_000199; the type-system changes were applied across replay_evt_000031–replay_evt_000040.

The assistant continued implementing the Clone Stamp tool in the FreetoShop editor. After the base capsule's covered segment (through replay_evt_000040), the assistant registered the tool in the tool registry (replay_evt_000041–000046), adding 'cloneStamp' to ToolFamilyId, a ToolDefinition entry (label 'Clone Stamp Tool', icon 'clone', family 'cloneStamp', slot 12, shortcut 'S'), and confirming the registry read-back. The 'clone' icon was missing from Icon.tsx, so the assistant added 'clone' to ICON_NAMES and defined its SVG paths (replay_evt_000047–000054). The assistant then moved to raster-engine/src/index.ts to implement the painting function. An initial edit added a CloneStampOptions interface and a paintCloneStamp function body, but the implementation contained placeholder logic and unresolved source-position handling (replay_evt_000055–000060). A subsequent edit rewrote CloneStampOptions to include sourceX/sourceY and began a corrected paintCloneStamp implementation that converts the document-space source position to source-layer local space and computes an aligned offset, but the provided source segment ends mid-implementation before the function is completed (replay_evt_000061).

The assistant implemented the Clone Stamp painting function in raster-engine/src/index.ts. After an initial edit failed to match the file text (replay_evt_000061–000064), the assistant read the file (replay_evt_000065–000066) and found the function already present with the corrected CloneStampOptions interface (including sourceX/sourceY) and a complete paintCloneStamp implementation. The implementation converts the document-space source position to source-layer local space, computes an aligned offset, interpolates stroke points into dabs with per-dab source positions (preserving offset in aligned mode, sampling the same source in unaligned mode), computes stroke bounds, reads the destination region and selection region, composites source pixels onto the destination with alpha blending and coverage falloff, and returns a patch from changed bounds. The assistant then planned to update ToolOptionsBar to show clone stamp options (replay_evt_000067).

The assistant updated ToolOptionsBar.tsx to add clone stamp options. First, it read the file (replay_evt_000068) and saw the existing ToolOptionsBarProps interface and component without clone stamp support. Then it planned to update ToolOptionsBar (replay_evt_000069). It edited the interface to add cloneAlignMode: 'aligned' | 'unaligned' and onCloneAlignModeChange callback (replay_evt_000071–000072). After reading the file again (replay_evt_000073), it confirmed the interface now includes cloneAlignMode and onCloneAlignModeChange (replay_evt_000074). The component body in the read output did not yet include the clone stamp option UI controls.

The assistant updated ToolOptionsBar.tsx to render clone stamp UI controls (size, opacity, alignment mode, source status) via an edit tool call (replay_evt_000075::span::000000–000001) and confirmed the file was edited (replay_evt_000076). It then ran the raster-engine tests, which passed (replay_evt_000077–000078). Next, it read toolRegistry.test.ts (replay_evt_000079–000080), ran the full test suite, and observed one failing test: toolRegistry.test.ts expected 9 tool families but received 10, with cloneStamp at slot 12 now present (replay_evt_000081–000082::span::000000–000004). The assistant then edited toolRegistry.test.ts to add cloneStamp at slot 12 and a shortcut test for 's' → cloneStamp (replay_evt_000083), confirmed the edit (replay_evt_000084), re-read the file to verify the new content (replay_evt_000085–000086), and began inspecting the raster-engine test file and repository structure to add clone stamp unit tests and understand the codebase (replay_evt_000087–000092).

The assistant continued implementing the Clone Stamp tool by adding unit tests. It read the raster-engine test file (replay_evt_000099, replay_evt_000100) and explored the repository structure (replay_evt_000101–000102). It then re-read the architecture and document model docs along with toolRegistry.ts (replay_evt_000103–000104::span::000000) to understand the existing systems before proceeding with clone stamp implementation.
